purpose: Frozen equal-category, equal-N comparison for Table 2 Naming direct metrics

design.interpretation: All methods contribute exactly seven assets in each of five noun-level categories. This controls category mixture and sample count, but does not control prompt wording, generator family, or release provenance.
design.old_nano3d_33_asset_pilot: not used to define Ours category capability; the five frozen reusable templates below are the capability evidence

ours.policy: generate one asset for each integer seed 0 through 6 for every frozen template

infinite_mobility.policy: select the existing successful factory outputs at integer seeds 0 through 6

lam.policy: from viable official-release records in the category whitelist, rank records independently within each canonical category by ascending SHA256 of the UTF-8 string below and select the first seven

articraft.policy: from eligible retained official-checkout records in the exact category, rank records independently within each canonical category by ascending SHA256 of the UTF-8 string below and select the first seven

microwave.definition: microwave cooking appliance; microwave oven is an accepted lexical synonym

oven.definition: standalone or built-in oven, excluding toaster ovens and microwave ovens

faucet.definition: water-control faucet; tap is an accepted lexical synonym

refrigerator.definition: refrigerator appliance; fridge and the release typo refrigerater are accepted lexical variants

direct_metrics: named renderable URDF links / all renderable URDF links
metric_policy.semantic_metrics: fail closed to null unless independent frozen gold and three blind judges exist
metric_policy.cross_seed: report only for reusable generators; LAM and Articraft release resampling is not cross-seed evidence
metric_policy.representation: URDF-link metrics only; do not merge with GLB-node metrics

bootstrap.procedure: sample five canonical categories with replacement; include all seven selected assets from every sampled category; compute each statistic on the resulting 35 asset slots
bootstrap.interval: percentile, endpoints at 0.025 and 0.975 using linear interpolation

completeness_gates: all source and template hashes match
each method has exactly seven eligible selected assets in every canonical category
selection does not depend on measured part count or nameability
all evaluated artifacts satisfy baseline_naming_protocol_v1.1 renderable-geometry rules
the comparison is labeled category-matched and never same-prompt
